propositions: The _MODEL_ID_CAPABILITY_OVERRIDES table omits claude-opus-4-8 (rebar's default model) and both us.* and global.* prefix variants, leaving them unguarded against temperature parameter rejections.
Both Bedrock and direct Anthropic adapters reject temperature parameter on opus-4-8 and opus-4-7 models, but only Bedrock path returns 400; Anthropic path silently drops the parameter with a warning.
Pass-2 code-review verification pins temperature=0 for determinism on claude-opus-4-8, but the parameter is actually ignored in production, causing silent nondeterminism in gate results.

The temperature parameter is not universally unsupported on opus models—temp=1.0 (API default) succeeds while 0.0 and 0.5 fail, indicating rejection of parameter tunability rather than the parameter itself.
The top_p parameter is also deprecated on opus-4-8 and opus-4-7 models but has no corresponding supports_top_p capability override, creating a latent defect.
